digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and author guides
propositions: Author guides currently distinguish Success Criteria (SC) for containers vs Acceptance Criteria (AC) for leaves, but the plan-review gate no longer enforces this split and guides must be rewritten to remove SC vocabulary

The leaf-vs-container section must be re-expressed to describe containers by their actual requirements (AC + child decomposition coverage + deferred testing) rather than a separate SC heading, or the guidance becomes vacuous
grep search for SC vocabulary across src/rebar/_guides/, docs/user-guide.md, and docs/llm-framework.md must return zero matches after rewrite
rebar explain plan output must render the updated guide with no SC vocabulary and exit successfully
Four permanent vocabulary carve-outs (T2 pilot language, dod_uncertifiable concept, completion.py line 288) must be explicitly excluded from the removal scope
